verdict.rationale: The axis applies to an AI coding-agent platform, but the evidence never shows an agent being triggered from a CI/CD pipeline to fix a broken build or failing test. The GitHub Actions mention only means existing CI runs on LightSprint PRs, and tests status is shown as a merge-readiness gate, not an auto-fix trigger. Tasks can be created from Slack, Linear or Jira, but no CI webhook, API or Action is documented, and the OpenAPI probes returned 404.
